steps.content: During the investigation, you uncover some evidence. It appears that malfunctioning cyborgs or machine units were present here and clashed with the FAC's security system. Nonetheless, there is no indication of Mania or involvement of the Underground Puppets.
The FAC left some suspicious traces at the scene untouched, yet thoroughly erased the signs of combat. Why did they do that?
If it was just their own mechanical units going berserk, why would the FAC withhold information from you? Could this be related to the pressure they've been put under during the election period?

options: I'd like to check those malfunctioning units.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: The FAC will conduct the investigation internally and share the report with the Bureau when it's complete. This is the Commander-in-Chief's order.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This could be connected to the election-related attacks. Doesn't the Commander also want to uncover the truth as soon as possible?

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: ...Chief, I believe the Commander has his reasons. I hope you can understand.
The soldier speaks with genuine sincerity. His respect for you is evident, which makes his position all the more difficult.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: ...It's just some malfunctioning old equipment. No cause for alarm. FAC will take care of this.

After all, the Commander explicitly rejected your investigation request during the recent meeting. The very fact that you are permitted to examine the scene today already signifies a small step forward.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Though he never says it directly, the Commander holds you in high regard and always instructs us to fully support your work.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: He's been worried about you lately, telling us to bolster security for you and the MBCC within the limits of our authority. There's a lot he keeps unsaid, but I believe that, too, is his way of protecting you.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Chief, there might be foes even more perilous than Mania that lurk in the dark. We are in a troubled time, so please take good care of yourself.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Take care of yourselves as well.
At the other end of the corridor, S9 watches ${PlayerName} from a distance.
Her built-in communicator suddenly chimes. She opens the channel, projecting the text onto the visor of her mask.

<color=#fb9259>Jelena:</color> How are things going? I hope it's not dangerous.
<color=#fb9259>S9:</color> Problem solved. But this won't be the end of it.
<color=#fb9259>S9:</color> If you really want to ensure ${PlayerName}'s safety, get those who are targeting him and take them down.
<color=#fb9259>Jelena:</color> I know. I'm working on it, but it takes time. Until then, I still need your help.
<color=#fb9259>S9:</color> I only wish to protect El. Besides, I still don't understand why you decided to entrust El to him.
<color=#fb9259>S9:</color> You know he has no connections or allies, and those behind him are just using him. No one will truly back him up. In DisCity, people like that won't last.
<color=#fb9259>Jelena:</color> ...Things will change. When change comes, status, wealth, connections—they might all crumble overnight.
<color=#fb9259>Jelena:</color> By then, only those who can stand up on their own will prove to be the most reliable.
<color=#fb9259>S9:</color> ...Elvira has us, and that is enough.
<color=#fb9259>Jelena:</color> But we alone cannot give her a stable life. You know that...

steps.content: In these turbulent times, S9 realizes it has been a long while since she last saw Elvira's smile.
...Of course, she wishes for Elvira to find her smile again.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: The bodyguard... will live with us too? That means she's family, right...?

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: For my birthday... will you celebrate with me?

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Sable! I hit the target!!

steps.speaker: S9
steps.content:
<color=#fb9259>S9:</color> ...I see. Protecting that Chief means protecting El.

<color=#fb9259>S9:</color> I found some leads while dealing with the threat today. I'll look into them.


<color=#fb9259>S9:</color> Tell El I'll be back soon.
After sending the final message, S9 turns off her communicator screen. Then, she takes one last glance from afar to ensure ${PlayerName}'s safety before departing.
However, days have passed, and S9 never returns.
...Looks like we've also got a visitor here.
He nudges the incapacitated cyborg S9 over with his foot.
An outdated model from N.F. 103. Not even worth salvaging.
But... I wonder how she managed to track us down...
